intro: Novo Place is an executive condominium in District 24, in the Tengah and Choa Chu Kang belt. Our project file lists Hoi Hup Realty and Sunway Developments as the developers. The file also carries a third-party expected TOP in the first quarter of 2027, but that figure was not verified on the developer’s own page, so it is not treated as a confirmed date here. Unit counts and tenure are likewise left out until we can cite an official source. If you are an owner approaching handover, use your sale documents and any letter from the developer as the source of truth for your own key date. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Novo Place renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Novo Place interior
sections.text:
District 24 is a growth corridor where new housing, new roads and new amenities have been arriving in stages. That matters for renovation only in practical ways: you may be planning a first home while the neighbourhood is still settling, and you will want storage that works from week one — school bags, bulk groceries, and a place to drop shoes and helmets — without waiting to “see how the estate feels”. The joinery that usually does that job is an entry cabinet, a living-room storage wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. Maison designs those as built-in carpentry, not as loose, flat-pack furniture.

We do not have an official floor plan on file for Novo Place, and we will not invent a typical unit type. EC estates often mix family typologies, but the only safe starting point is your approved plan. With that in hand we can tell whether the living and dining share one long wall (a good place for a continuous media and storage run), whether a common bedroom can take a built-in desk, and how far the kitchen can go before it meets a structural wall or a supplied appliance bank. Close-up material studies — stone, veneer, laminate, profiled doors — are as useful as a wide room view when you are choosing a look.

If your expected handover is in 2027, you still have time to lock a design, but not an unlimited amount once fabrication lead times are included. The sober sequence is: confirm the key appointment, inspect defects, measure, submit the management renovation application, then build. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial allowance only. WhatsApp Maison with your plan and any key letter you already have, and we will work from those, not from a guess.
